question: The marks in Mathematics and English of S are in proportion. Last year when he got 60 marks in Mathematics, he secured 75 marks in English. If his marks in English this year are 60, then his Mathematics marks are _____.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Mathematics to English marks = 60 : 75 = 4 : 5

Current English marks = 5 units = 60

1 unit = 60 ÷ 5 = 12

Current Mathematics marks = 4 units = 4 × 12 = 48

**∴ The correct answer is 48 marks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Mathematics marks last year (M₁) = 60

English marks last year (E₁) = 75

English marks this year (E₂) = 60
